Title: Azure Defender for SQL now in general availability on the Azure SQL Virtual Machine blade
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
As we work on adding more features to SQL Server IaaS Agent extension and the SQL Virtual Machine blade, we are excited to bring the Azure Defender for SQL Virtual Machine experience right from the SQL Virtual Machine blade.

Previously, you went through multiple steps to access Azure Security Center to view and manage the best practices of security for your databases on SQL Server Virtual Machines. This experience is now easier if you are registered to an SQL IaaS Agent extension. Access the entire Azure Defender suite from the same place you manage other SQL Virtual Machine features such as automated backup, licensing, and security configurations like Azure Key Vault integration.

Learn more by visiting the Tech Community Blog.
